name: Taxdoo
what: VAT and accounting compliance automation for cross-border e-commerce sellers.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; Visionaries Club participated in the Series A; Growth Fund I lists Taxdoo GmbH among its 2023 shareholdings (North Data).
membership.quote: with participation from Visionaries Club, 20VC and existing investor HTGF

entry.quote: Leading the Series A round is venture capital firm Accel

funding_rounds.note: Register: capital increase registered 2021-01-19 (Taxdoo GmbH HRB 141469).
'Tiger Global, Accel, Visionaries Club und 20VC investierten in der Series B zuletzt 57 Millionen Euro'

valuation.quote: No valuation disclosed for the Series A or B.

notes: Visionaries was new in the Series A (earlier investor HTGF). Since then Taxdoo has been an acquirer, not a target: it bought 100% of accountDigital (Mülheim-Kärlich) in May 2025 (startupcity.hamburg: 'The Hamburg-based fintech scaleup Taxdoo has acquired 100 per cent of accountDigital'), its third acquisition that year. Consequence worth knowing: taxdoo.com's imprint now names Accounting-digital-Unternehmensberatungsgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG (Mülheim-Kärlich) as publisher, while Taxdoo GmbH remains registered in Hamburg (address change 2026-07-31, North Data). No later equity round found (googlenews 'Taxdoo' after 2022-06 -> only the 2022 fund article). Agrees with the 20VC, Accel and Tiger rows on status and HQ.
